# Vendored STIX 2.1 validation inputs

These files are immutable build inputs copied from the exact OASIS source
archives pinned in `standards/sources.json`:

- JSON schemas: `oasis-open/cti-stix2-json-schemas` commit
  `c4f8d589acf2bdb3783655c89e0ffb6e150006ae`
- STIX pattern grammar: `oasis-open/cti-pattern-validator` commit
  `e1d38d6895339976888fe243782e8da5b574657e`

Do not edit these files directly. Update the source manifest, verify checksums,
and replace the complete pinned source set when adopting a newer authoritative
revision. OASIS license terms are preserved in `LICENSE`.
